description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a compositor client, including display, surface, and input device abstractions within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: IDisplay
classes.description: Interface for display management in the compositor, including methods for creating surfaces and retrieving display info.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface
classes.description: Interface representing a drawable surface with methods for rendering and configuration.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for surface rendering and publishing events.

classes.name: IDisplay::ITouchPanel
classes.description: Interface for touch panel input handling.

methods.name: IDisplay::SuggestedName
methods.description: Retrieves a suggested display name based on environment variable 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIER'.

methods.name: IDisplay::Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves additional configuration info from 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIER' environment variable.
